subject.title: fix(synology-chat): bound outbound NAS response bodies to prevent Gateway OOM

question: Should Synology Chat adopt the proposed 64 KiB/30-second chatbot and 1 MiB/15-second user-list response budgets as hard compatibility boundaries?
rationale: The limits prevent remote memory exhaustion, but they intentionally reject oversized or long-running responses that current releases continue reading, so the permanent budgets require maintainer ownership rather than an inferred implementation default.

options.title: Accept the proposed budgets
options.body: Land the limits as written, treating oversized or excessively long NAS responses as invalid and preserving cached user fallback.

options.title: Recalibrate before merge
options.body: Choose larger bounded limits or longer total-read deadlines if maintainers expect legitimate Synology installations to exceed the proposed budgets.

recommendation.title: Accept the proposed budgets
recommendation.body: Land the limits as written, treating oversized or excessively long NAS responses as invalid and preserving cached user fallback.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged history shows repeated ownership of Synology client hardening and behavior calibration.
